gloss: extent of a rise; margin of increase

definitions.gloss: extent of a rise; size of an increase; margin of gain
definitions.explanation: How far something has gone up — a price, a stock index, a temperature — stated as the size of the movement rather than the final figure. Common in news reporting on markets and weather.

examples.japanese: {上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The rise in the stock price was the largest on record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧になって、⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In the afternoon, the temperature rise turned out to be smaller than expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{上昇幅|じょうしょうはば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: They say this price increase will be held to within three percent.

notes:
⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ (width) attaches to many words of change to name the size of the movement, so this family is worth learning together.

FORMS:
- ⟦{下落幅|げらくはば}→下落幅：30175_gerakuhaba⟧: extent of a drop — the direct opposite
- ⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧: size of a price increase
- ⟦{伸|の}び→伸び：19827_nobi⟧⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧: extent of growth
